parsed_entries.requirement: A Certifying Authority must comply with conditions and restrictions specified by regulations to maintain recognition under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Certifying Authority is subject to conditions and restrictions specified by regulations.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities recognized under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation relates to the conditions and restrictions that must be followed by recognized Certifying Authorities.

parsed_entries.requirement: A Certifying Authority must maintain compliance with the conditions and restrictions to avoid revocation of recognition.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Certifying Authority has been revoked for non-compliance with conditions and restrictions.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities recognized under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures that Certifying Authorities remain compliant with the conditions and restrictions for their recognition.

parsed_entries.requirement: A Certifying Authority must obtain prior approval from the Central Government before being recognized under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Certifying Authority received prior approval from the Central Government for recognition.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities recognized under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires Certifying Authorities to obtain prior approval from the Central Government before being recognized.

parsed_entries.requirement: A Certifying Authority must issue valid electronic signature certificates that are recognized under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the electronic signature certificate issued by the Certifying Authority is valid under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities recognized under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures that electronic signature certificates issued by Certifying Authorities are valid under the IT Act 2000.

parsed_entries.requirement: A person seeking to issue electronic signature certificates must apply for a licence from the Controller under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the applicant has applied for a licence to issue electronic signature certificates.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to persons seeking to issue electronic signature certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation requires applicants to obtain a licence from the Controller before issuing electronic signature certificates.

parsed_entries.requirement: A person seeking to issue electronic signature certificates must meet prescribed requirements for qualification, expertise, and infrastructure.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the applicant meets the prescribed requirements for qualification, expertise, and infrastructure.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to persons seeking to issue electronic signature certificates.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures that only qualified and capable entities are granted the right to issue electronic signature certificates.
